entries.title: Exodus 29:1
segments: ¶This is what you are to do to make them holy, to do the work of priests to me: Take one young ox and two male sheep, without any mark on them,

entries.title: Exodus 29:2
segments: And unleavened bread, and unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and thin unleavened cakes on which oil has been put, made of the best bread-meal;

entries.title: Exodus 29:3
segments: Put these in a basket and take them, with the ox and the two sheep.

entries.title: Exodus 29:4
segments: And let Aaron and his sons come to the door of the Tent of meeting, and there let them be washed with water.

entries.title: Exodus 29:5
segments: Take the robes, and put the coat and the dress and the ephod and the priest's bag on Aaron; put the band of needlework round him,

entries.title: Exodus 29:6
segments: And let the head-dress be placed on his head and the holy crown on the head-dress.

entries.title: Exodus 29:7
segments: Then take the oil and put it on his head.

entries.title: Exodus 29:8
segments: And take his sons and put their robes on them;

entries.title: Exodus 29:9
segments: And put the linen bands round Aaron and his sons, and the head-dresses on them, to make them priests by my order for ever: so you are to make Aaron and his sons holy to me.

entries.title: Exodus 29:10
segments: Then let the ox be taken in front of the Tent of meeting: and let Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

entries.title: Exodus 29:11
segments: And you are to put the ox to death before the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting.

entries.title: Exodus 29:12
segments: Then take some of the blood of the ox, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, draining out all the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

entries.title: Exodus 29:13
segments: And take all the fat covering the inside of the ox, and the fat joining the liver and the two kidneys with the fat round them, and let them be burned on the altar;

entries.title: Exodus 29:14
segments: But the flesh of the ox and its skin and its waste parts are to be burned outside the circle of the tents, for it is a sin-offering.

entries.title: Exodus 29:15
segments: Then take one of the sheep, and let Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

entries.title: Exodus 29:16
segments: Then let it be put to death, so that the sides of the altar are marked with its blood.

entries.title: Exodus 29:17
segments: Then the sheep is to be cut up into its parts, and after washing its legs and its inside parts, you are to put them with the parts and the head,

entries.title: Exodus 29:18
segments: And let them all be burned on the altar as a burned offering to the Lord: a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

entries.title: Exodus 29:19
segments: Then take the other sheep; and after Aaron and his sons have put their hands on its head,

entries.title: Exodus 29:20
segments: You are to put the sheep to death, and take some of its blood and put it on the point of Aaron's right ear, and of the right ears of his sons, and on the thumbs of their right hands and the great toes of their right feet, dropping the rest of the blood on the sides of the altar.

entries.title: Exodus 29:21
segments: Then take some of the blood on the altar, and the oil, and put it on Aaron and his robes and on his sons and on their robes, so that he and his robes and his sons and their robes may be made holy.

entries.title: Exodus 29:22
segments: Then take the fat of the sheep, the fat tail, the fat covering the insides, and the fat joining the liver and the two kidneys with the fat round them, and the right leg; for by the offering of this sheep they are to be marked out as priests:

entries.title: Exodus 29:23
segments: And take one bit of bread and one cake of oiled bread and one thin cake out of the basket of unleavened bread which is before the Lord:

entries.title: Exodus 29:24
segments: And put them all on the hands of Aaron and of his sons, to be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.

entries.title: Exodus 29:25
segments: Then take them from their hands, and let them be burned on the burned offering on the altar, a sweet smell before the Lord, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

entries.title: Exodus 29:26
segments: Then take the breast of Aaron's sheep, waving it before the Lord; and it is to be your part of the offering.

entries.title: Exodus 29:27
segments: So you are to make holy the breast of the sheep which is waved and the leg which is lifted up on high, that is, of the sheep which is offered for Aaron and his sons;

entries.title: Exodus 29:28
segments: And it will be their part as a right for ever from the children of Israel, it is a special offering from the children of Israel, made from their peace-offerings, a special offering lifted up to the Lord.

entries.title: Exodus 29:29
segments: And Aaron's holy robes will be used by his sons after him; they will put them on when they are made priests.

entries.title: Exodus 29:30
segments: For seven days the son who becomes priest in his place will put them on when he comes into the Tent of meeting to do the work of the holy place.

entries.title: Exodus 29:31
segments: Then take the sheep of the wave offering and let its flesh be cooked in water in a holy place.

entries.title: Exodus 29:32
segments: And let Aaron and his sons make a meal of it, with the bread in the basket, at the door of the Tent of meeting.

entries.title: Exodus 29:33
segments: All those things which were used as offerings to take away sin, and to make them holy to be priests, they may have for food: but no one who is not a priest may have them, for they are holy food.

entries.title: Exodus 29:34
segments: And if any of the flesh of the offering or of the bread is over till the morning, let it be burned with fire; it is not to be used for food, for it is holy.

entries.title: Exodus 29:35
segments: All these things you are to do to Aaron and his sons as I have given you orders: for seven days the work of making them priests is to go on.

entries.title: Exodus 29:36
segments: Every day an ox is to be offered as a sin-offering, to take away sins: and by this offering on it, you will make the altar clean from sin; and you are to put oil on it and make it holy.

entries.title: Exodus 29:37
segments: For seven days you are to make offerings for the altar and make it holy, so that it may become completely holy, and anything touching it will become holy.

entries.title: Exodus 29:38
segments: ¶Now this is the offering which you are to make on the altar: two lambs in their first year, every day regularly.

entries.title: Exodus 29:39
segments: One lamb is to be offered in the morning and the other in the evening:

entries.title: Exodus 29:40
segments: And with the one lamb, a tenth part of an ephah of the best meal, mixed with a fourth part of a hin of clear oil; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

entries.title: Exodus 29:41
segments: And the other lamb is to be offered in the evening, and with it the same meal offering and drink offering, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

entries.title: Exodus 29:42
segments: This is to be a regular burned offering made from generation to generation, at the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord, where I will come face to face with you and have talk with you.

entries.title: Exodus 29:43
segments: There I will come face to face with the children of Israel, and the Tent will be made holy by my glory

entries.title: Exodus 29:44
segments: I will make holy the Tent of meeting and the altar: and Aaron and his sons I will make holy, to be my priests

entries.title: Exodus 29:45
segments: Among the children of Israel I will make my living-place, and I will be their God.

entries.title: Exodus 29:46
segments: And they will see that I am the Lord their God, who took them out of the land of Egypt, so that I might be ever with them: I am the Lord their God.
